phase_note: Generated 2026-10-04/05 by the Phase 10 spec batch (wave 2) in auto-approve mode. 12 requirements / 79 acceptance criteria; 11 design components; 8 major / 21 leaf tasks ((P): 2.1, 2.2, 4.1, 4.2; 8.3 maintainer-only). Research: three read-only Explore subagents surveyed the codebase in parallel; about fifteen DuckDB probes across twelve 1.x releases ran in network-blocked scratch venvs (sandbox-exec deny network, fresh HOME); no research downgrade. Step 3.5 task-graph review ran as an independent reviewer dispatched by the controller, twice. Round 1: NEEDS_FIXES (14 should-fix, 9 nit), all applied, including the controller ruling that the skill-example pin is keyed on the producer and that the second lander may touch exactly three read-side files. Round 2: NEEDS_FIXES (2 should-fix, 4 nit), applied without a third review because the skill bounds the loop at one re-review. Assumes three upstream issues against analytics-index (task 1.1 stops and reports on each): U1 duckdb floor >=1.2,<2; U2 fetch errors wrapped like execute; U3 the contract names query-spill-<pid>/. Accepted trade-off: design.md exceeds the template's 1000-line advisory; it carries the sandbox contract, the output value rules and the per-class test mutations agents and reviewers depend on.
